# See what changed after a consent choice.

> Compare before-and-after consent browser traces and create a local request and storage change record.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/consent-change-record/)
- [Consent Change Record vs. comparing the two traces by eye](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/consent-change-record/vs-comparing-the-traces-by-eye.html)
- [Consent Change Record vs. Cookiebot](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/consent-change-record/vs-cookiebot.html)
- [What did my cookie banner actually change?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/consent-change-record/what-did-my-cookie-banner-actually-change.html)
